improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your AI-powered trade and business assistant. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for trade and operations. Try three free searches today."/>
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"/>
<meta property="og:description" content="Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace for business owners, traders, and professionals. Start with three free searches."/>
<meta property="og:type" content="website"/>
<meta property="og:url" content="https://www.gdn.ai/"/>
<meta property="og:image" content="https://www.gdn.ai/og-image.jpg"/>
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"/>
<meta name="twitter:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | AI Trade & Business Assistant"/>
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Professional AI support for trade and operations. Try three free searches with Gideon."/>
improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon offers and the free trial hook. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical for B2B audiences who discover tools via social shares. Including the free searches offer in both descriptions creates a low-friction conversion path directly from the preview.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for professionals. Try three searches free — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces the product name and its core function, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while clearly stating the risk-free trial offer. 'No card required' removes friction and increases click-through. Copy is concise, benefit-driven, and speaks directly to the target audience of business owners and traders.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens when the free trial ends. It reassures visitors there's no surprise, clearly states the low entry price, and reinforces value props while nudging toward the annual plan. Reduces abandonment at the paywall stage.
